spans.s:
निर् निर् euphonically substituted for निस्,
q. v., before vowels and soft consonants.

निरंश निर्-अंश, अस्, आ, अम्, having no part
or fraction remaining, whole.
—निरंश-त्व, अम्,
n. the state of having no part or fraction over,
wholeness, completeness.

निरंशु निर्-अंशु, उस्, उस्, उ, having no rays,
rayless.

निरग्नि निर्-अग्नि, इस्, इस्, इ, or निरग्निक, अस्,
आ, अम्, having no fire, having lost or neglected the
consecrated fire.

निरघ निर्-अघ, अस्, आ, अम्, sinless, blame-
less, free from fault or imperfection.

निरङ्कुश निर्-अङ्कुश, अस्, आ, अम्, unchecked
(lit. not held by a hook), uncontrolled, unruly, self-
willed, unfettered, independant, completely free;
(अम्), ind. freely.
—निरङ्कुश-ता, f. or निरङ्कुश-
त्व, अम्, n. unruliness, independance, self-will, wil-
fulness.

निरङ्ग निर्-अङ्ग, अस्, आ, अम्, having no re-
sources, deprived of expedients.

निरज् निर्-अज्, cl. 1. P. -अजति, -अजितुम् (Ved.
inf. -अजे), Ved. to drive or bring out, extricate, re-
move; to issue out.

निरजिन निर्-अजिन, अस्, आ, अम्, without a
skin or hide, skinless.

निरञ्छन नि-रञ्छन, अम्, n. (fr. रञ्छ् =
लञ्छ् with नि), a mark or knot in a measuring line.

निरञ्जन 1. निर्-अञ्जन, अस्, आ, अम्, without
collyrium or ointment, unstained, untinged, unblack-
ened, unpainted; free from falsehood; artless; (अस्),
m. an epithet of Śiva; N. of one of the attendants
of Śiva; (आ), f. an epithet of Durgā; the day of
full moon.

निरञ्जन 2. नि-रञ्जन, अस्, आ, अम्, void of
passion or emotion, (applied to the Supreme Being.)

निरण् नि-रण्, cl. 1. P. -रणति, -रणितुम्,
Ved. to rejoice, delight in.
निरत नि-रत. See नि-रम्, p. 492, col. 2.

नीरत नी-रत, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. निस् + रत),
not delighting in, not attached to, indifferent.

निरतिशय निर्-अतिशय, अस्, आ, अम्, unsur-
passed.
—निरतिशय-त्व, अम्, n. the state of being
unsurpassed, unsurpassedness.

निरत्यय निर्-अत्यय, अस्, आ, अम्, free from
danger, dangerless, secure, infallible, completely
successful, faultless, unblamable.

निरधिष्ठान निर्-अधिष्ठान, अस्, आ, अम्, hav-
ing no fixed resting-place, having no solid basis.

निरध्व निर्-अध्व, अस्, आ, अम्, (probably)
one who has lost his way.

निरनुक्रोश निर्-अनुक्रोश, अस्, m. absence of
compassion, hard-heartedness, unmercifulness; (अस्, आ,
अम्), uncompassionate, without pity, pitiless, merci-
less; hard-hearted towards any person or thing (with
loc.).
—निरनुक्रोश-कारिन्, ई, इणी, इ, acting without
compassion or pitilessly.
—निरनुक्रोश-ता, f. piti-
lessness, unmercifulness; hard-heartedness, cruelty.
—निरनुक्रोश-युक्त, अस्, आ, अम्, uncompassionate,
ruthless, hard-hearted.

निरनुग निर्-अनुग, अस्, आ, अम्, unattended,
without retinue or followers.

निरनुग्रह निर्-अनुग्रह, अस्, आ, अम्, unfa-
vourable, unkind, ungracious.

निरनुनासिक निर्-अनुनासिक, अस्, आ, अम्, not
marked with the nasal symbol called Anunāsika
(
Gram. 7
), not nasal.

निरनुमान निर्-अनुमान, अस्, आ, अम्, without
inference, not binding one's self to conclusions or
consequences.

निरनुरोध निर्-अनुरोध, अस्, आ, अम्, unfa-
vourable, unfriendly, unkind, ungracious, unamiable.

निरन्तर निर्-अन्तर, अस्, आ, अम्, without any
intermediate space, having no intervening space,
granting no room or free space, having no interval,
closely contiguous, close; closely connected, conti-
nuous; uninterrupted, continual, constant; without
interstices, completely filled, compact, dense, coarse,
gross; persevering, faithful, true (as a friend); un-
concealed, not hidden from view; not other or dif-
ferent, similar, identical; (अम्), ind. without inter-
vening space, without interval, without interruption,
constantly, incessantly, continually; closely, tightly,
firmly; immediately.
—निरन्तराभ्यास (˚र-अभ्˚),
अस्, m. constant repetition or study, continual reading
to one's self; diligent and uninterrupted exercise or
practice.

निरन्तराल निर्-अन्तराल, अस्, आ, अम्, without
an intervening space, without intervals or interstices;
close, contracted, narrow.
—निरन्तराल-ता, f. close
contiguity, closeness, compactness, narrowness.

निरन्धस् निर्-अन्धस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, foodless,
without food, hungry.

निरन्न निर्-अन्न, अस्, आ, अम्, foodless, want-
ing food, hungry, starving; giving no food.

निरन्वय निर्-अन्वय, अस्, आ, अम्, having no
offspring or descendants, childless; unconnected with,
unrelated; not agreeing with the context (of a sen-
tence); without logical connection, without regular
order or sequence, unmethodical; without being seen
or observed, out of sight, not visibly committed
(Manu
VIII. 332

निरप निर्-अप, अस्, आ, अम्, waterless, desti-
tute of water.

निरपत्रप निर्-अपत्रप, अस्, आ, अम्, shame-
less, impudent; bold, confident.

निरपराध निर्-अपराध, अस्, m. faultless-
ness, innocence; (अस्, आ, अम्), unoffending, inoffen-
sive, innocent, faultless, guiltless, blameless.
—निर्-
अपराध-ता, f. faultlessness, innocence.
—निरप-
राध-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, faultless, innocent.

निरपवर्त निर्-अपवर्त, अस्, आ, अम्, not re-
turning or turning back; (in arithmetic) leaving no
common measure, not to be divided by a common
divisor, reduced to the lowest terms.

निरपवाद निर्-अपवाद, अस्, आ, अम्, free from
censure, without reproof, blameless.

निरपाय निर्-अपाय, अस्, आ, अम्, free from
destruction or decay, imperishable, eternal, free from
detriment or loss, free from harm or evil; infallible.

निरपेक्ष निर्-अपेक्ष, अस्, आ, अम्, disregard-
ing, not taking notice of (with loc.); careless, negli-
gent, without desire, indifferent; not expecting any-
thing from another; independant of, unconnected or
unconcerned with; (often without any object) re-
gardless, indifferent (to praise or blame); without
purpose or hope; (आ), f. indifference; disregard,
the absence of expectation; (अम्), n. without regard,
regardlessly, accidentally.
—निरपेक्ष-ता, f. or
निरपेक्ष-त्व, अम्, n. disregard, indifference;
independance; relationlessness.
निर्-अपेक्षित, अस्, आ, अम्, disregarded; regardless.

निर्-अपेक्षिन्, ई, इणी, इ, disregarding, indifferent,
not expecting anything.
निर्-अपेक्ष्य, अस्, आ, अम्, not to be regarded.

निरभिभव निर्-अभिभव, अस्, आ, अम्, not
subject to defeat or humiliation, not disgraced; not to
be surpassed.

निरभिमान निर्-अभिमान or निर्-अभीमान,
अस्, आ, अम्, exempt from pride, free from self-con-
ceit, devoid of egotism; unconscious.

निरभिलाष निर्-अभिलाष, अस्, आ, अम्, having
no desire for, not intent upon, indifferent.

निरभ्र निर्-अभ्र, अस्, आ, अम्, cloudless; (ए),
ind. in a cloudless sky, when the sky is unclouded.

निरम् नि-रम्, cl. 1. A. -रमते, -रन्तुम्,
Ved. to delight in, be delighted; to rest, repose,
desist: Caus. -रामयति, -यितुम्, Aor. -अरीरमत्,
Ved. to gladden; to cause to rest or abide.
नि-रति, इस्, f. delighting in; attachment to.

नि-रमण, अम्, n. delighting in; resting; (in
Śata-patha-Brāhmaṇa
XIII. 4, 2, 5

, नि-रमण is
by some separated into निर्-अमण and explained to
mean ‘exhausted,’ ‘worn out.’)

निरमर्ष निर्-अमर्ष, अस्, आ, अम्, not im-
patient; patient, apathetic, devoid of energy.

निरमित्र निर्-अमित्र, अस्, आ, अम्, without
foes, free from enemies; (अस्), m., N. of several
persons; of a son of Nakula; of a king of Tri-garta;
of a son of Khaṇḍa-pāṇi or Daṇḍa-pāṇi, (also निर्-
आमित्र); of a son of Ayutāyus; of a sage, con-
sidered as a son of Śiva, (also निर्-आमित्र.)
निरामित्र निर्-आमित्र. See निर्-अमित्र.

निरम्बर निर्-अम्बर, अस्, आ, अम्, undressed,
naked.

निरम्बु निर्-अम्बु, उस्, उस्, उ, abstaining from
water, not drinking; waterless, destitute of water.

निरय निर्-अय, अस्, m. ‘without happiness,’
hell [cf. तिर्यन्-निरय]; Niraya or Hell personified
as a child of fear and death; (according to some
निर्-अय, in the sense of ‘hell,’ is fr. निर्-इ and means
‘exit,’ ‘egress from life.’)

निराय निर्-आय, अस्, आ, अम्, having no in-
come or revenue, profitless, yielding no income or
profit.
—निर्-आय-व्यय-वत्, आन्, m. having neither
income nor expenditure, an idler who lives by clan-
destine means.
निर्-अयण, अम्, n., Ved. egression.

निरर्गल निर्-अर्गल, अस्, आ, अम्, unbarred,
without a bolt or hindrance, unobstructed, unrestrained,
unimpeded; irresistible; (अम्), ind. without bolt or
bar; without restraint or constraint, freely.

निर्-अर्थक, अस्, आ or इका or अकी (?), अम्, not
fulfilling one's aim or object, purposeless, useless, vain,
unprofitable; having no reasonable sense, unmeaning,
nonsensical; a consonant which is not followed by a
vowel; (अम्), ind. without a purpose, uselessly, in
vain.
—निरर्थक-त्व, अम्, n. uselessness, vanity.

निरर्द् निर्-अर्द्, cl. 1. P. -अर्दति, -अर्दितुम्,
Ved. to stream forth, flow out.

निरर्बुद निर्-अर्बुद, अस्, m.? (with Bud-
dhists) N. of a hell in which the wicked are punished
by excessive cold.

निरव निर्-अव, अस्, आ, अम्? (occurring only
in the gen. sing. निर्-अवस्य, which might be the
ind. part. of rt. सो with preps. निर् and अव; said by
others to be = नि = निस् + रव, अस्, m. loss of voice;
but according to Sāy.) Ved. having no protector or
uttering praise.

नीरव नी-रव, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. निस् + रव),
soundless.

निरवकाश निर्-अवकाश, अस्, आ, अम्, without
free space; having no room for moving freely,
wanting an opportunity, without leisure.

निरवग्रह निर्-अवग्रह, अस्, आ, अम्, without
obstruction or obstacle, unrestrained, unchecked, un-
controlled; irresistible; free, independant; self-willed,
unmanageable, headstrong.

निरवत्त निर्-अव-त्त, निर्-अव-त्ति. See un-
der निर्-अव-दो, col. 3.

निर्-अव-त्त, अस्, आ, अम्, distributed, completely
divided or allotted.

निरवदय् निर्-अव-दय्, cl. 1. A. -दयते,
Ved. to distribute, allot a share or shares.

निरवदो निर्-अव-दो [cf. 3. दा], cl. 2. 4. P.,
[]
Ved. -दाति and -द्यति, -दातुम्, to distribute, allot
a share, give any one his share, to satisfy a claim; to
divide completely among.

निर्-अव-त्ति, इस्, f., Ved. allotment or distribution
of shares.

निरवद्य निर्-अवद्य, अस्, आ, अम्, unblamable,
blameless, faultless, unobjectionable, unexceptionable;
(अम्), n. (or आ?), f. unblamableness, blamelessness,
faultlessness; (अस् or अम्), m. or n. (?), a particular high
number.
—निरवद्य-त्व, अम्, n. blamelessness,
unblamableness, excellence.
—निरवद्य-वत्, आन्,
अती, अत्, unblamable, blameless.

निरवधि निर्-अवधि, इस्, इस्, इ, without bounds
or boundaries, unlimited.

निरवयव निर्-अवयव, अस्, आ, अम्, without
limbs or members, without component parts, not
consisting of parts, indivisible.
—निरवयव-त्व,
अम्, n. indivisibility.

निरवरोध निर्-अवरोध, अस्, आ, अम्, unre-
strained, unobstructed, unopposed.

निर्-अवलम्बन, अम्, n. want of a prop, want
of reliance, want of a person or thing to depend
upon.

निरवशेष निर्-अवशेष, अस्, आ, अम्, without
a residue, complete, whole; (एण), ind. completely,
totally, fully, particularly, circumstantially.
—निर्-
अवशेष-तस्, ind. completely, &c. (= निरवशे-
षेण).

निरवसाद निर्-अवसाद, अस्, आ, अम्, not cast
down, cheerful, good-humoured.

निरवस्कृत निर्-अवस्कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, cleansed,
clean?; [cf. अवस्-कर, अन्-अवस्कर.]

निरवस्तार निर्-अवस्तार, अस्, आ, अम्, without
a bed or coverlet; not strewn (with leaves &c.), bare.

निरवहालिका निर्-अवहालिका, f. a fence, a
hedge, an outer wall; [cf. अवहालिका.]

निरविन्द निरविन्द, अस्, m., N. of a moun-
tain.

निरवेक्ष् निर्-अवेक्ष् (-अव-ईक्ष्), cl. 1. A.
-ईक्षते, -ईक्षितुम्, to perceive.
निर्-अवेक्ष्य, ind. having perceived or observed.

निरव्यय निर्-अव्यय, अस्, आ, अम्, undecaying,
eternal.

निरश् निर्-अश्, cl. 9. P. -अश्नाति, &c., Ved.
to eat up, consume entirely.

निरस् निर्-अस्, cl. 4. P. -अस्यति, -असितुम्, to
cast out, throw away, drive away, banish, expel, evict,
drive back, send back; to keep off; to turn out (of
doors); to reject, repudiate, decline, refuse; to re-
move; to tear out, strip off; to stretch out (e. g.
हस्तौ निरस्यति or -ते, he stretches out the hands);
to annihilate, destroy, subdue.

निर्-अशित, अस्, आ, अम्, eaten up, completely con-
sumed.

निरशन निर्-अशन, अस्, आ, अम्, abstaining
from food; (अम्), n. going without food, fasting.

निर्-असन, अस्, ई, अम्, expelling, removing, re-
jecting; vomiting, spitting out; (अम्), n. expelling,
ejecting; expulsion, removal, rejection, denial, con-
tradiction, refusal, disallowance; vomiting forth,
spitting out; suppressing, checking; killing, destroy-
ing, destruction, extermination.
निर्-आसन, अम्, n. = निर्-असन, p. 492, col. 3.

नीरसन नी-रसन, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. निस् + र-
सना), having no girdle.

निर्-असनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be thrown out, to be
driven away or expelled.

निर्-अस्त, अस्, आ, अम्, cast out or away, expelled;
thrown out or away, cast off; thrown off (as from a
horse); driven away, expelled, banished; rejected,
repudiated, abandoned, deserted; disallowed; re-
futed; sent forth, sent away; deprived of, removed;
shot off, discharged (as an arrow); spit out; uttered
hurriedly or rapidly (as a speech or word); torn out
or away; destroyed; broken (as an agreement);
suppressed, checked; (अम्), n. rejecting; dropping
or leaving out, not pronouncing (regarded as a fault
in pronunciation).
—निरस्त-भेद, अस्, आ, अम्,
having all difference removed, identical.
—निरस्त-
राग, अस्, आ, अम्, one who has abandoned worldly
desires or has devoted himself to religious penance.

1. निर्-अस्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be expelled or driven
out.

2. निरस्य, ind. having cast out, thrown out or
ejected, having expelled.

निर्-अस्यमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being thrown out or
expelled; being abandoned; being suppressed, &c.

निर्-आस, अस्, m. throwing out, casting out, ejection,
expulsion, removal, abandonment; dropping (a sound
or letter &c.); vomiting; opposing, contradiction,
refutation.
—निरास-गुटिका, f. a pill to produce
vomiting; (also written निराश-गुटिका.)

निरास निर्-आस, अस्, m. See under निर्-अस्
at p. 493, col. 1.

निरस नि-रस, अस्, आ, अम्, = नी-रस, without
flavour, tasteless, insipid, dry; (अस्), m. want of
flavour, insipidity; want of juice, dryness; want of
passion or feeling; (आ), f. a species of grass (= निः-
श्रेणिका).

निराश निर्-आश, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. निस् + 1. आ-शा;
cf. आ-शंस्), without hope, hopeless, despairing of
(with loc., dat., or with प्रति and acc., e. g. स्व-
जीविते or स्व-जीविताय or स्व-जीवितम् प्रति निर्-
आशः, despairing of one's own life); depriving of all
hope; [cf. नैराश्य.]
—निराश-त्व, अम्, n. hope-
lessness, despair.
—निराशी-भाव, अस्, m. hopeless-
ness, despair.
—निराशी-भूत, अस्, आ, अम्, become
hopeless; despairing.

नीरस नी-रस, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. निस् + रस),
without juice, sapless, dried up, withered; flavourless,
unsavoury, tasteless, devoid of taste, flat, dry; insipid;
vain; (अस्), m. the pomegranate.
—नीरस-ता, f. the
state of being devoid of taste, tastelessness.

निरस्त्र निर्-अस्त्र, अस्, आ, अम्, weaponless,
unarmed; (fought) without weapons (as a battle).

निरस्थि निर्-अस्थि, इस्, इस्, इ, having no bones,
boneless.

निरह् निर्-अह्, only in perf. निर्-आह, Ved.
to utter, pronounce, express.

निर्-अहङ्कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, having no self-con-
sciousness, without individuality or personality; un-
selfish.

निर्-अहङ्कृति, इस्, इस्, इ, free from egotism or
selfishness.

निर्-अहङ्क्रिय, अस्, आ, अम्, having no individu-
ality or personality, without self-consciousness.
निर्-अहङ्क्रिया, f. absence of egotism or selfishness.

निरहम् निर्-अहम् or निर्-अहम्मति, इस्, इस्,
इ, devoid of self-conceit, free from selfishness.

निराक निराक, अस्, m. cooking; sweat; the
recompense of a bad action; (wrong reading for
नि-पाक.)

निराकरण निर्-आकरण. See under निर्-
आ-कृ, col. 2.

नि-रुद्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, stopped, obstructed, re-
strained, checked, hindered, opposed; confined, im-
prisoned; (अस्), m., N. of a prince.
—निरुद्ध-
कण्ठ, अस्, आ, अम्, having the breath obstructed,
suffocated.
—निरुद्ध-गुद, अस्, m. contraction or
obstruction of the rectum.
—निरुद्ध-प्रकश,
अस्, m. stricture of the urethra.
—निरुद्ध-शम-
वृत्ति, इस्, इस्, इ, ‘whose state of repose is interrupted,’
wearied, tired.

नि-रुन्धत्, अन्, अती, अत्, checking, hindering,
suppressing, &c.

नि-रुन्धान, अस्, आ, अम्, obstructing, opposing,
hindering, preventing; depriving of, &c.

नि-रोद्धव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be shut in or confined,
to be fenced, to be enclosed with a fence or hedge.

निरोद्धव्य नि-रोद्धव्य, नि-रोध, &c. See
col. 1.

नि-रोध, अस्, m. shutting in, confinement, locking
up, imprisonment; enclosing, covering up; check,
restraint, coercion, suppression, hindrance, prevention,
obstruction, opposition; annihilation, destruction;
(in dramatic language) disappointment, frustration of
hope; hurting, injuring (= नि-ग्रह); aversion,
disfavour, dislike; (with Buddhists) suppression or
annihilation of pain (one of the four principles); N.
of a man.

नि-रोधक, अस्, आ, अम्, obstructive, obstructing,
confining, hindering.

नि-रोधन, अस्, ई, अम्, confining, obstructing;
(अस्), m. (with अवट) N. of a hell; (अम्), n. con-
finement, imprisonment; keeping back, restraining,
keeping down, coercion; denying; (in dramatic
language) disappointment, frustration of hope.
नि-रोधिन्, ई, इनी, इ, obstructing, hindering.

निरुपक्रम निर्-उपक्रम, अस्, आ, अम्, having
no beginning, without a commencement.

निरुपद्रव निर्-उपद्रव, अस्, आ, अम्, free
from hostile attacks, free from ravages, not visited
by calamity or affliction, free from adversity or
danger, lucky, happy, undisturbed, unharmed, un-
molested; free from national distress, free from
tyranny; causing no affliction or adversity; peaceful,
secure; not inauspicious (as a star).
—निरुपद्रव-
ता, f. absence of calamity or danger, security.

निर्-उपद्रुत, अस्, आ, अम्, not visited by calamities;
not boding evil (as a star).

निरुपधि निर्-उपधि, इस्, इस्, इ, without guile,
guileless, honest, secure.

निरुपपत्ति निर्-उपपत्ति, इस्, इस्, इ, unfit, un-
suitable.
—निरुपपत्ति-त्व, अम्, n. unfitness, un-
suitableness.

निरुपपद निर्-उपपद, अस्, आ, अम्, not con-
nected with a subordinate word; [cf. उप-पद.]

निरुपप्लव निर्-उपप्लव, अस्, आ, अम्, free
from calamity or disturbance, free from trouble or
alarm; unharmed; not causing adversity; an epithet
of Śiva.

निरुपभोग निर्-उपभोग, अस्, आ, अम्, not
enjoying, destitute of enjoyment.

निरुपम निर्-उपम, अस्, आ, अम्, peerless,
matchless, without a compeer or equal, unequalled,
incomparable; (अस्), m. a species of poisonous animal
(= गौधेरक).

निरुपल निर्-उपल, अस्, आ, अम्, stoneless,
free from stones.

निरुपलेप निर्-उपलेप, अस्, आ, अम्, un-
smeared, free from ointment.

निरुपसर्ग निर्-उपसर्ग, अस्, आ, अम्, free
from portents, not portentous.

निरुपस्कृत निर्-उपस्कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, uncor-
rupted, inartificial, pure.

निरुपहत निर्-उपहत, अस्, आ, अम्, unhurt,
uninjured, not afflicted; auspicious.

निरुपाख्य निर्-उपाख्य, अस्, आ, अम्, not
perceptible by the eyes, invisible, immaterial; unreal,
false, non-existent.

निरुपाधिक निर्-उपाधिक, अस्, आ, अम्, without
attributes or qualities.

निरुपाय निर्-उपाय, अस्, आ, अम्, without
expedients, remediless, helpless; unsuccessful.

निरुपेक्ष निर्-उपेक्ष, अस्, आ, अम्, not neg-
lectful; free from trick or fraud.

निरुप्ति निर्-उप्ति, इस्, f. (fr. rt. वप् with निस्),
= 1. निर्-वाप, q. v.
निर्-उप्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be scattered or sprinkled.

1. नि-रूप्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be seen or defined or
ascertained.

2. नि-रूप्य, ind. having seen or considered.
—निरूप्य-ता, f. or निरूप्य-त्व, अम्, n. ascer-
taining, determining.

निरुब्ज् निर्-उब्ज्, cl. 6. P. -उब्जति, &c., Ved.
to press down, cause to flow down, send down, let
loose.

निरुष्णीष निर्-उष्णीष, अस्, आ, अम्, without
a turban or head-dress, bare-headed.

निरुष्मन् निर्-उष्मन्, आ, आ, अ, devoid of
heat, cold.
—निरुष्म-त्व, अम्, n. absence of heat,
coldness.
निरूष्मन् निर्-ऊष्मन्. See निर्-उष्मन्.

निरूढ 1. नि-रूढ, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. नि-रुह्),
inherent, conventional, accepted (as the familiar
meaning of words in opposition to their etymological
sense); (अस्), m. (in rhetoric) the force or application
of words according to their natural or received
meanings; (in logic) the inherence of any property
in the term implying it (as of redness in the word
red &c.).

निरूढ 2. निर्-ऊढ, आ, f. (fr. rt. वह् with
निस्), unmarried.

3. निर्-ऊढ, अस्, आ, अम्, drawn out, purged,
eviscerated; (for 2. निर्-ऊढ see above.)
—निर्-
ऊढ-पशु-प्रयोग, अस्, m., N. of a treatise on
particular sacrifices, (see the next.)
—निरूढ-
पशु-बन्ध, अस्, m. ‘the offering or oblation of an
eviscerated animal,’ N. of one of the regular Havir-
yajñas.

निरूप् नि-रूप्, cl. 10. P. -रूपयति, -यितुम्,
to perform; to represent, enact, act dramatically; to
see, perceive, look at, look into; to observe, con-
sider, reflect upon; to investigate, examine, look
out for, discover, search; to ascertain; to select,
choose, appoint; to resolve, determine.

नि-रूपण, अस्, ई, अम्, defining, determining;
(अम्), n. form, shape; sight, seeing; looking for,
searching; looking into, investigation, determination,
definition; ascertaining, defining, (in these senses
also नि-रूपणा.)

नि-रूपणीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be looked for; to be
searched into or examined, to be investigated.

नि-रूपयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, looking for, investi-
gating, considering.

नि-रूपित, अस्, आ, अम्, seen, beheld; discovered,
found; appointed, elected, chosen, deputed; consi-
dered, weighed; ascertained, determined, resolved.

नि-रूपिति, इस्, f. definition (of an idea), ascertain-
ment.

निरूह् निर्-ऊह् [cf. rt. 1. ऊह्], cl. 1. P. A.
-ऊहति, -ते, &c., Ved. inf. निर्-ऊहितवै, to push
out, draw out, remove: Caus. -ऊहयति, -यितुम्,
to cause to draw out or purge.

निर्-ऊढि, इस्, f. (also to be referred to rt. वह्
with निस्), fame, celebrity, renown.

1. निर्-ऊह, अस्, m. a purging clyster; an enema
not of an oily kind, = नि-ग्रह?; (for 2. निर्-
ऊह see below.)
—निरूह-वस्ति-विधि, इस्, m., N.
of the twenty-fifth chapter of the Śārṅga-dhara-saṃ-
hitā, a medical work by Śārṅga-dhara.
—निरूहा-
धिकार (˚ह-अध्˚), अस्, m., N. of a chapter of a
medical work by Vṛnda.

निरूह 2. निर्-ऊह, अस्, m. (fr. rt. 2. ऊह् with
निस्), logic, disputation; certainty, ascertainment.
(For 1. निर्-ऊह see above; for 3. see next col.)

निरूह 3. निर्-ऊह, अस्, m. (for 1. and 2.
see col. 2), a sentence having no ellipsis, a complete
sentence.

1. निर्-ऊहण, अम्, n. causing to purge with a
clyster; administering enemas not of an oily kind.
(For 2. निर्-ऊहण see below.)
2. निर्-ऊहण, अम्, n. ascertainment.
निर्-ऊहित, अस्, आ, अम्, purged.

निरृ निर्-ऋ, cl. 3. P. -इयर्ति, &c., Ved. to
go out from, depart from, liberate one's self from
(with abl.); to be excluded, to become deprived of
(with abl.); Caus. निर्-अर्पयति, -यितुम्, to cause
to go to pieces or decay, to dissolve.

निर्-ऋत, अस्, आ, अम्, dissolved, decaying; debili-
tated; (अस्), m., N. of a Rudra.

निर्-ऋति, इस्, f. decay, dissolution, destruction, anni-
hilation, calamity, evil, adversity; imprecation, curse;
Decay or Destruction personified (goddess of death
and corruption; she is described as binding mortals
with her cords, and is often associated with Mṛtyu,
A-rāti, and similar beings; she is variously regarded
as the wife of A-dharma, mother of Bhaya, Mahā-
bhaya, and Mṛtyu, or as a daughter of A-dharma and
Hiṃsā and mother of Naraka and Bhaya; she is
regent of the south-west or south-western quarter
and of the asterism Mūla); (इस्), f. the bottom or
lower depths of the earth (perhaps regarded as the
seat of putrefaction; cf. नैरृत); (इस्, इस्, इ), free
from adversity, (in this sense निर् is a privative.)

निरृछ् निर्-ऋछ्, cl. 6. P. -ऋच्छति, &c.,
Ved. to go out from, fall from, be excluded from
(with abl.); to go or cleave asunder.

निरे निर्-ए (निर्-आ-इ), cl. 2. P. निर्-ऐति, Ved.
to come forth from, to go off, depart, make way for.

निरेक नि-रेक, अस्, m. (fr. rt. रिच् with नि),
Ved. a lasting possession (?), wealth, property; (ए),
ind. lastingly, for ever; (Sāy.) in poverty or want; in
donation or gifts; (according to Mahī-dhara) not
empty.

निरेभ नि-रेभ, अस्, आ, अम्, soundless, noise-
less.
निर्गत निर्-गत. See निर्-गम् below.

निर्-गत, अस्, आ, अम्, gone out, come forth, come
out, appeared; gone away, departed; disappeared,
extinct; freed from.
—निर्गत-विशङ्क, अस्, आ,
अम्, freed from fear, fearless.

निर्गन्ध निर्-गन्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, inodorous,
scentless, unfragrant, void of smell.
—निर्गन्ध-ता,
f. absence of smell, want of fragrance, scentlessness.
—निर्गन्ध-पुष्पी, f. the silk-cotton tree (=
शाल्मलि), Bombax Heptaphyllum.

निर्गन्धन निर्गन्धन, अम्, n. = निर्ग्रन्-
थन, killing, slaughter.

निर्गम् निर्-गम्, cl. 1. P. -गच्छति, -गन्-
तुम्, to go out, come forth, depart from (with abl.),
set out; to come out or appear (as a bud); to go
away, disappear; to be freed from (with abl.); to enter
into any state, undergo (with acc.): Desid. -जिगमि-
षति, to wish to go out.
निर्-ग, अस्, m. country, region; place or province.

-गातुम्, Ved. to go out, come forth.

निर्-गम, अस्, m. going forth or out, setting out,
going away, receding; departure, vanishing; exit,
issue, outlet; a door; [cf. जल-न्˚.]
निर्-गमन, अम्, n. going out or forth.

निर्गर्व निर्-गर्व, अस्, आ, अम्, free from
pride, humble, lowly.

निर्गल् निर्-गल्, cl. 1. P. -गलति, &c., to
trickle or flow out; to dissolve, melt.
—निर्-गलित,
अस्, आ, अम्, flowed out, poured forth; dissolved,
melted.

निर्गवाक्ष निर्-गवाक्ष, अस्, आ, अम्, window-
less, without windows.

निर्गुण निर्-गुण, अस्, आ, अम्, stringless (as
a bow); devoid of all qualities or properties; without
attributes; having no epithet; devoid of good
qualities or virtues, bad, worthless, vicious; (अस्), m.
the Supreme Being (as without qualities of any kind).
—निर्गुण-ता, f. or निर्गुण-त्व, अम्, n. absence
of qualities, want of properties, freedom from all
qualities (as an attribute of the Supreme Being);
absence or want of good qualities, wickedness, vicious-
ness, baseness.
—निर्गुणात्मक (˚ण-आत्˚), अस्, आ,
अम्, having no qualities.

निर्गुण्टी निर्गुण्टी or निर्गुण्डी or निर्गुण्डि,
इस्, f. the shrub Vitex Negundo; another plant (=
नील-शेफालिका); the root of a lotus.

निर्गुप् निर्-गुप्, cl. 1. P. -गोपायति, &c., to
guard, protect.

निर्गुल्म निर्-गुल्म, अस्, आ, अम्, free from
bushes, destitute of shrubs.

निर्गूढ निर्-गूढ, अस्, m. (fr. rt. गुह् with
निस्), the hollow of a tree.

निर्गृह निर्-गृह, अस्, आ, अम्, houseless,
homeless.

निर्गॄ निर्-गॄ, cl. 6. P. -गिरति or -गिलति, &c.,
to vomit forth.
—निर्-गीर्ण, अस्, आ, अम्, vomited
forth.

निर्गौरव निर्-गौरव, अस्, आ, अम्, destitute
of respect; without dignity, undignified, affable; (अम्),
ind. without pride, condescendingly, affably.

निर्ग्रन्थ निर्-ग्रन्थ, अस्, आ, अम्, freed from
all ties or hindrances; a saint, a devotee who has
withdrawn from the world and lives either as a
hermit or a beggar wandering about naked; pos-
sessionless, poor, a pauper, beggar [cf. ग्रन्थ, said
to mean ‘riches’]; (अस्), m. an idiot; a fool; a
gambler; N. of a man, son of Jñāti.
—निर्ग्रन्थ-
शास्त्र, अम्, n., N. of a work.

निर्-ग्रन्थक, अस्, आ, अम्, unattended, unac-
companied; abandoned, deserted; fruitless; clever,
expert, conversant; (अस्), m. a religious mendicant;
a naked devotee; a gambler; (अस्, अम्), m. n. (?),
Buddhism (because the Buddhists appeared as religious
mendicants, especially as ascetics).
निर्-ग्रन्थि, इस्, इस्, इ, free from knots, knotless.

निर्-ग्रन्थिक, अस्, m. a naked mendicant, an
ascetic; (अस्, आ, अम्), clever, conversant; = हीन,
destitute (?).

निर्ग्रन्थन निर्-ग्रन्थन, अम्, n. killing,
slaughter; [cf. नि-ग्रन्थन, नि-गन्धन.]

निर्ग्राह्य निर्-ग्राह्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be traced
or found out, perceivable.

निर्घट निर्-घट, अम्, n. a fair or crowded
market, a free market, a wharf or ghaut where no
toll is levied, a place where there is no quay or stairs,
(in this sense निर् is a privative.)

निर्घण्ट निर्-घण्ट or निर्-घण्टक, अस्,
अम्, m. n. a vocabulary, a collection of words, =
नि-घण्टु, (perhaps for निर्-ग्रन्थक, ‘singling
out the words of a sentence and writing them down
in their independent form.’)

निर्घात निर्-घात, अस्, m. (fr. rt. हन् with
निस्), destruction; a violent gust of wind, hurricane,
whirlwind; the noise of contending vapours in the
sky; an earthquake; a thunder-stroke; any severe
stroke.
निर्-घातन, अम्, n. forcing out, bringing out.

निर्-घात्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be forced or brought
out.

निर्घुष्ट निर्-घुष्ट, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. घुष्
with निस्), sounded, resounded.

निर्-घोष, अस्, m. sound in general, noise, a
loud noise, rattling, trampling; (अस्, आ, अम्), sound-
less, noiseless, (in this sense निर् is a privative.)
—निर्घोषाक्षर-विमुक्त (˚ष-अक्ष्˚), अस्,
m., N. of a Samādhi.
निर्घोष निर्-घोष. See निर्-घुष्ट above.

निर्घूरिणी निर्-घूरिणी, f. a river, (perhaps
a wrong reading for निर्-झरिणी.)

निर्घृण निर्-घृण, अस्, आ, अम्, unmerciful,
pitiless, cruel; shameless, immodest; (अम्), ind.
without pity, pitilessly.
—निर्घृण-ता, f. or निर्-
घृण-त्व, अम्, n. pitilessness, unmercifulness, hard-
heartedness, cruelty.
निर्-घृणा, f. unmercifulness, cruelty.

to rub against or on (with loc.).
निर्-घर्षण, अम्, n. rubbing, friction.

निर्घर्षणक, अस्, आ, अम्, who or what rubs,
a rubber, rubbing, a rubbing, a dentifrice fit for
cleaning the teeth.

निर्-घृष्य, ind. having rubbed, having rubbed
on.

निर्जन निर्-जन, अस्, आ, अम्, unpeopled, de-
populated, uninhabited, unfrequented, lonely, de-
serted, desolate; (अम्), n. a solitude, desert.
—निर्-
जन-ता, f. or निर्जन-त्व, अम्, n. depopulation,
the state of being unpeopled or deserted.
—निर्जन-
वन, अम्, n. a lonely or unfrequented forest.

निर्जर 1. निर्-जर, अस्, आ, अम्, (for 2. see
निर्-जॄ, col. 3), not becoming old, young, fresh;
imperishable, immortal, undecaying; (अस्), m. an
immortal, a deity, god; (आ), f. the plant Cocculus
Cordifolius; Anethum Graveloens, = तत्त्व-भिद्;
(अम्), n. ambrosia, the food of the gods.
—निर्-
जर-सर्षप, अस्, m. a species of mustard (=
देव-सर्षप).

2. निर्-जर, अस्, आ, अम्, completely wearing down
or destroying. (For 1. निर्-जर see col. 2.)

निर्-जरस्, optionally substituted for 1. निर्-जर
in certain cases. (See Pāṇ.

निर्जरायु निर्-जरायु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. skin-
less (as a snake which has cast its skin).

निर्जर्जल्प निर्-जर्जल्प, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. (ac-
cording to Mahī-dhara, probably because of its simi-
larity to जर्जर, =) ragged, tattered; (another read-
ing has निर्-जाल्मक.)

निर्जल निर्-जल, अस्, आ, अम्, waterless, desti-
tute of water, dry, desert; not mixed with water
(as buttermilk); (अस्), m. a desert, waste.
—निर्जल-

stinacy; importunity, urgency, pressing or urging
anything, (निर्बन्धं कृ, to urge); accusing,
accusation; contest, dispute; caprice, fancy?; [cf.
णि-बन्ध.]
—निर्बन्ध-पृष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्,
urgently asked, importuned.

निर्-बन्धनीय, अम्, n. (perhaps) contest, dis-
pute.

निर्-बन्धिन्, ई, इनी, इ, insisting upon (with loc.),
urgent, persisting in, intent upon.

निर्बन्धु निर्-बन्धु, उस्, उस्, उ, without re-
lations, without kindred, friendless.

निर्बर्हण निर्-बर्हण, अम्, n. = नि-वर्हण,
slaughter, killing, destroying, annihilation.

निर्बल निर्-बल, अस्, आ, अम्, powerless, with-
out strength, impotent, weak, feeble.

निर्बाध् निर्-बाध्, cl. 1. A. -बाधते, -बा-
धितुम्, Ved. to keep off, ward off, hold back.

निर्बाधिन्, ई, इनी, इ, Ved. furnished with knobs or
prominences.

निर्बुद्धि निर्-बुद्धि, इस्, इस्, इ, senseless,
witless, unwise, ignorant, stupid, out of one's wits.

निर्बुसीकृत निर्बुसी-कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, freed
from chaff, husked.

निर्ब्रू निर्-ब्रू, cl. 2. P. -ब्रवीति, &c., Ved.
to speak out, pronounce (loud or clearly); to inter-
pret, explain.
निर्भक्त निर्-भक्त. See निर्-भज् below.

निर्-भक्त, अस्, आ, अम्, excluded from partici-
pation in; taken without eating (as medicine; in
this sense निर् is a privative).
निर्भग्न निर्-भग्न. See निर्-भञ्ज् below.

निर्-भग्न, अस्, आ, अम्, broken in pieces; broken
down; bent.
—निर्-भज्यमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being
broken in pieces.

निर्भज् निर्-भज्, cl. 1. P. A. -भजति, -ते,
-भक्तुम्, Ved. to exclude from participation or
coparceny (with abl.): Caus. -भाजयति, -यितुम्, to
exclude from sharing in, to disinherit.

निर्-भाज्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be excluded from
participation in, to be debarred from sharing in.
निर्भाज्य निर्-भाज्य. See निर्-भज् above.

निर्भञ्ज् निर्-भञ्ज्, cl. 7. P. -भनक्ति,
-भङ्क्तुम्, to break asunder, split asunder; to
defeat.

निर्भट निर्-भट, अस्, आ, अम्, hard, firm,
compact; (perhaps a wrong reading.)

निर्भय निर्-भय, अस्, आ, अम्, fearless, un-
daunted; free from danger, secure; (अस्), m., N. of
a son of the thirteenth Manu; (अम्), ind. fearlessly,
without danger.

निर्भर निर्-भर, अस्, आ, अम् [cf. भर],
excessive, exceeding, vehement, violent; deep, sound
(as sleep); ardent; beyond measure, much; (at the
end of a comp.) full of, filled with; (अस्, अम्),
m. n. essence?; (अम्), ind. excessively, exceed-
ingly, very much; soundly, deeply.

निर्भर्त्स् निर्-भर्त्स्, cl. 10. P. A. -भर्त्स-
यति, -ते, -यितुम्, to threaten, menace, abuse, re-
buke, reprimand, chide, blame, deride.

निर्-भर्त्सन, अम्, आ, n. f. threatening, threat,
menace; abuse, reviling, reproach, blame; malignity;
red paint, lac.
—निर्भर्त्सन-दण्ड-मोहित, अस्,
आ, अम्, bewildered by the threat of punishment.

निर्-भर्त्सित, अस्, आ, अम्, threatened, menaced;
reviled, abused.

निर्-भर्त्स्य, ind. having threatened; having
reviled or reproached.

निर्भस् निर्-भस्, cl. 3. P. -बभस्ति, -बप्-
सति, &c., Ved. to bite off, chew.

निर्भास् निर्-भास्, Caus. -भासयति, -यितुम्,
to illuminate.

निर्भा निर्-भा, cl. 2. P. -भाति, -भातुम्,
to shine forth, appear, arise, proceed.

निर्-भात, अस्, आ, अम्, shone forth, shining forth,
appeared, arisen.

निर्भाग्य निर्-भाग्य, अस्, आ, अम्, unlucky,
unfortunate.
निर्-भासित, अस्, आ, अम्, illuminated, illumined.

निर्भिद् निर्-भिद्, cl. 7. P. A. -भिनत्ति,
-भिन्त्ते, -भेत्तुम्, to cleave or split asunder, break
in two, rend, divide, separate, open; to break through,
pierce, penetrate, wound; to put out (the eyes); to
break down, destroy; to divulge, betray; to find
out, detect, discover; to excavate: Pass. -भिद्यते,
to be broken asunder, to cleave or split open (intrans.);
to burst asunder.

निर्-भिद्य, ind. having broken through, having
pierced or penetrated.

निर्-भिन्न, अस्, आ, अम्, broken asunder, pierced,
divided.
—निर्भिन्न-तनु, उस्, उस्, उ, having the
body pierced through or transfixed.

निर्-भेद, अस्, m. breaking or splitting asunder,
bursting, dividing, a split, rent; the bed or channel
of a river; the issue or termination of an affair,
event.
निर्भेद निर्-भेद, निर्-भेद्य. See निर्-भिद्.
निर्-भेदिन्, ई, इनी, इ, splitting asunder, piercing.

निर्-भेद्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be split asunder; having
[]
no rent; missing an aim; disappointed; (in the last
three senses निर् is a privative.)

निर्भीत निर्-भीत, अस्, आ, अम्, fearless, not
afraid.

निर्भुज् निर्-भुज्, cl. 6. P. -भुजति, -भोक्-
तुम्, to bend on one side, bend awry, distort;

wry face.)

निर्-भुग्न, अस्, आ, अम्, bent awry, distorted;
not bent, straight, (in this sense निर् is a privative.)

निर्-भुज, अस्, आ, अम्, a term applied to a kind
of Sandhi (or Saṃhitā).

निर्भू निर्-भू, cl. 1. P. -भवति, -भवितुम्,
Ved. to come out, move out, move.
निर्-भूति, इस्, f., Ved. disappearing, passing away.

निर्भृ निर्-भृ, cl. 1. 3. P. -भरति, -बि-
भर्ति, -भर्तुम्, to take out, draw out.

निर्-भृत, probably a wrong reading for नि-
भृत.

निर्भृति निर्-भृति, इस्, इस्, इ, without wages,
hireless.

निर्भोग निर्-भोग, अस्, आ, अम्, not devoted
to pleasure or enjoyment.

निर्मज् निर्-मज्, Ved. (according to Sāy.)
completely pure (as cows).

निर्मज्ज् निर्-मज्ज्, cl. 1. P. -मज्जति, &c.,
to sink under, sink into; to inundate, deluge.

निर्-मग्न, अस्, आ, अम्, sunk, sunk into, sunk
under, (opposed to उन्-मग्न.)

निर्मज्ज निर्-मज्ज, अस्, आ, अम्, fatless, mar-
rowless, meagre.

निर्मण्डूक निर्-मण्डूक, अस्, आ, अम्, frogless,
destitute of frogs.

निर्मत्सर निर्-मत्सर, अस्, आ, अम्, without
envy, unenvious, free from envy or passion.

निर्मत्स्य निर्-मत्स्य, अस्, आ, अम्, fishless,
destitute of fish.
—निर्मत्स्य-ता, f. absence of fish,
the having no fish.

निर्मथ निर्-मथ, निर्-मथन. See under
निर्-मन्थ् below.

निर्-मथ, अस्, m. stirring, rubbing.
—निर्मथ-
दारु = निर्मन्थ-दारु.

निर्मद निर्-मद, अस्, आ, अम्, unintoxicated,
sober, quiet; not proud, humble; not in rut (as an
elephant).

निर्मध्य निर्-मध्य, अस्, आ, अम्, having no
middle; (आ), f. = नलिका, a fragrant substance; [cf.
निर्-मथ्या below.]

निर्मनस्क निर्-मनस्क, अस्, आ, अम्, mindless,
having no Manas.
—निर्मनस्क-ता, f. the having
no Manas.

निर्मनुज निर्-मनुज, अस्, आ, अम्, abandoned
by men (as a forest), desolate, uninhabited.

निर्मनुष्य निर्-मनुष्य, अस्, आ, अम्, un-
peopled, uninhabited, deserted by men, without a
man; (मातङ्गो निर्मनुष्यस्, an elephant with-
out riders.)

निर्मन्त्र निर्-मन्त्र, अस्, आ, अम्, unaccom-
panied by holy texts or the recitation of sacred verses
(as the Gandharva marriage).

निर्मन्थ् निर्-मन्थ् or निर्-मथ्, cl. 1. 9. P.
-मथति, -मन्थति, -मथ्नाति, &c., to stir about,
agitate, churn, shake about, toss about roughly or
violently; to rub, elicit fire by rubbing; to strike,
[]
beat violently, thresh, bruise, crush, stamp to pieces,
grind, break in pieces, destroy.

निर्-मथन, अम्, n. stirring, churning, rubbing,
rubbing two pieces of wood together to light a fire.

निर्-मथित, अस्, आ, अम्, stirred about, agitated,
churned.

rubbed; (आ), f. a kind of fragrant substance, =
नलिका; [cf. निर्-मध्या above.]

having discriminated or particularized.

निर्-मथ्यमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being shaken or
tossed about roughly.

निर्-मन्थ, अस्, m. rubbing.
—निर्मन्थ-दारु,
उस्, उ, m. n. or निर्मन्थ-काष्ठ, अम्, n. the
wood used for kindling fire by friction; a churning-
stick.

निर्-मन्थन, अम्, n. rubbing, churning; sepa-
rating, distinguishing, discriminating.

churned; to be excited by friction (as fire); to be
distinguished or discriminated.

निर्-माथिन्, ई, इनी, इ, crushing or stamping to
pieces, churning, rubbing.

निर्मन्यु निर्-मन्यु, उस्, उस्, उ, free from
anger or resentment; (उस्), m., N. of a hunter.

interested; regardless, indifferent to (with loc.); free
from all connection with the outer world; an epithet
of Śiva; (अस्), m. (with Jainas) N. of the fifteenth
Arhat of the future Ut-sarpiṇī.
—निर्मम-ता, f. or
1. निर्मम-त्व, अम्, n. unselfishness, disregard of
worldly interests, indifference towards (with loc.).

2. निर्-ममत्व, अस्, आ, अम्, free from selfishness,
indifferent.

निर्मर्याद निर्-मर्याद, अस्, आ, अम्, boundless,
having no limits, immeasurable, innumerable; trans-
gressing the boundaries of right, unrestrained, unruly,
wicked, criminal, sinful, impious; confused; (अम्),
n. confusion, disturbance of boundaries or rules;
N. of a kind of fight; (अम्), ind. confusedly,
topsy-turvy.

virtuous; (अम्), n. talc; the remains of an offering

or moral).
—निर्मली-कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, freed from
impurity, cleansed, cleared.
—निर्मलोपल (˚ल-
उप्˚), अस्, m. crystal.

निर्-मल; (आ), f. a species of medicinal plant, see
पृक्का; (अम्), n. stainlessness, purity, cleanness, clear-
ness; the remains of an offering to a deity, flowers
left at a sacrificial ceremony; remains in general.
—निर्माल्य-ता, f. = निर्मल-ता.

निर्माल्य निर्-माल्य. See under निर्-मल,
col. 1.

निर्मशक निर्-मशक, अस्, आ, अम्, free from
gnats or musquitoes.

fabricate; to produce, create; to compose; to cause:

built.

measure; reach, extent, (एक-निर्माण, अस्, आ, अम्,
of the same measure; ककुदोदग्र-निर्माण, as
high as the top of a mountain; अव्यक्त-निर्माणो
बालस्, a boy who has not yet reached his full
growth, not yet full grown); forming, making, pro-
ducing, creating, production, fabrication, manufacture,
formation, creation, building; composing, composi-

tion, work; a building; a part; (with Buddhists) trans-
formation; the best of anything, pith, marrow,

—निर्मातृ-त्व, अम्, n. creatorship, the condition
of a maker or builder or producer.

निर्-मित, अस्, आ, अम्, constructed, manufactured,
produced, built, fashioned, fabricated, formed, made;
artificial; meted out; (आस्), m. pl. (with Buddhists) N.
of a class of deities, ‘the transformed.’

निर्-मिति, इस्, f. formation, production, creation,
fabrication, manufacture, artificial production; making.

निर्मांस निर्-मांस, अस्, आ, अम्, fleshless,
emaciated.

निर्मान निर्-मान, अस्, आ, अम्, without self-
confidence, free from pride.

निर्मानुष निर्-मानुष, अस्, आ, अम्, unpeopled,
uninhabited, abandoned by men, desolate; (ए), ind.
in a solitary place.

निर्मार्ग 1. निर्-मार्ग, अस्, आ, अम्, roadless,
pathless. (For 2. निर्-मार्ग see under निर्-मृज्.)

2. निर्-मार्ग, अस्, m. (for 1. see above), rubbing
or stripping off, wiping off; that which is stripped
or wiped off, refuse.

-मोक्तुम्, to loosen, free from, liberate.

निर्-मुक्त, अस्, आ, अम्, loosed, set free, liberated,
disjoined, sundered, separated, &c.; (अस्), m. a snake
which has lately cast his skin.

निर्-मुक्ति, इस्, f. liberation, deliverance; [cf.

ing; a hide or skin, especially the cast off skin or

निर्मोक निर्-मोक, निर्-मोक्तृ, &c. See
under निर्-मुच्, col. 2.

निर्-मोक्तृ, ता, त्री, तृ, one who solves or
liberates, a liberator, looser, solver (of doubts).
निर्-मोचन, अम्, n. liberation, deliverance.

prived of roots (as a tree); baseless, without origin,
unfounded; eradicated.

ness, baselessness.

निर्-मूलन, अम्, n. uprooting, eradicating, ex-
tirpating.

निर्-मूलय, Nom. P. निर्मूलयति, -यितुम्, to
uproot, eradicate, extirpate, annihilate.

out, sweep out, strip off.

निर्-मार्गुक, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. drawing off,
withdrawing, separating.

निर्-मार्जन, अम्, n. wiping off, sweeping,
cleaning.

निर्-मृष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, rubbed out, wiped off
or out, swept.

of the fifth Manu; of one of the Saptarṣis under

निर्-यात्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be given back or

undiscriminating, wanting discrimination or judg-

निर्-वेशनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be gained or enjoyed.

grass, Kyllingia Monocephala, used as an antidote.

rated from sensual objects, not attached to them (as

birds, free from birds.

निर्विहार निर्-विहार, अस्, आ, अम्, having no

निर्वीरुध् निर्-वीरुध्, त्, त्, त्, deprived of

powerlessness.

निर्वृत निर्-वृत, निर्-वृति. See under निर्-

prince of the Kaliṅgas; (probably wrongly for नि-

clusion; (in grammar) cessation of the influence of

priety, incivility [cf. निर्-वर्तिन् above]; final beati-
tude (for निर्-वृति); abstaining from action, inac-
tivity (for नि-वृत्ति); (इस्, इस्, इ), having no occu-
pation, destitute, (in this sense निर् is a privative.)
निर्वृक्ष निर्-वृक्ष, अस्, आ, अम्, treeless.

execution; desisting (for नि-वर्तन).

निर्-वर्तनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be completed or
accomplished.

executing; behaving rudely or uncivilly, uncivil.

formable, to be pronounced or uttered, pronounceable.

nounceableness.

performed or finished; having ceased, (for नि-वर्त्य.)

निर्वृष् निर्-वृष्, cl. 1. P. -वर्षति, -वर्-
षितुम्, to cease to rain.
निर्-वृष्टि, इस्, f. cessation of rain, want of rain.

निर्वृष निर्-वृष, अस्, आ, अम्, deprived of
bulls.

निर्वेग निर्-वेग, अस्, आ, अम्, without violent
motion or impetuosity, not waving, quiet, calm.

ing wages, unsalaried.

with कर्ण, a peculiar deformity of the ear.

निर्वेपन निर्-वेपन, अस्, आ, अम्, not trem-
bling, not flickering (as the flame of a lamp).

shuttle.
निर्-वैरिण, अम्, n. absence of enmity, concord.

forward or downright manner; plainly, without
verbosity; silently (?).

निर्व्यथ निर्-व्यथ, अस्, आ, अम्, free from

निर्-व्यथन, अम्, n. a hole, chasm (a place of
rest); freedom from pain; paining, afflicting, (in
this sense निर् is a prep.)

निर्व्यपेक्ष निर्-व्यपेक्ष, अस्, आ, अम्, disre-
garding, indifferent to (with loc.).

cerely, sincere, genuine, undissembling; (अम्), ind.
sincerely, readily.
—निर्व्यलीक-तस्, ind. sincerely.

troubled or disquieted, not excited, calm.

व्याकुल-ता, f. freedom from trouble, calmness;

निर्हिम निर्-हिम, अम्, n. cessation of winter.

निर्हेति निर्-हेति, इस्, इस्, इ, weaponless, un-

n. causelessness.

नीरोग्य-ता, f. health, freedom from sickness,
(perhaps an error for नीरोग-ता.)

नीरोह नी-रोह, अस्, m. (fr. निस् + रुह्), Ved.
shooting out, growing.
निरयिन्, ई, m. an inhabitant of hell.

निर्-आयति, इस्, इस्, इ, one who has no future, one
whose end is at hand, soon to be destroyed.

निर्-ओष्ठ्य, अम्, n. a verse containing no labial
letter.
निर्-मार्ष्टि, इस्, f., N. of the wife of Duḥsaha.
